biotools.summary: Chemoproteogenomics is a platform that integrates chemoproteomics, whole exome, and RNA-seq data to reveal the landscape of cysteine genetic variation, utilizing a customized two-stage FDR controlled proteomic search and a user-friendly FragPipe interface.
